merkbox.usage: Handlungen in der Zukunft, Vermutungen, Vorhersagen, Träume
merkbox.question: (question word +) Will … + verb

items.prompt: Kevin wird auf den Baum klettern.
Kevin will auf den Baum klettern.
Die Kinder werden einen Eistee trinken.
Die Kinder wollen einen Eistee trinken.

exercises.title: Find and correct mistakes, if possible.

items.text: I'll have a word with you.
We wont spend money on trash.
Will Julie arrives in London at 10 o'clock?
Our team wills win the match.
She won't worry about the weather yesterday.
The thief will tell the police the truth.
Cara won't wear sneakers at the party.
My parents not will sign the test.
Little John will build a sand castle at the beach.

exercises.title: Put the following sentences into their positive, negative and question forms, please. (Ask for the underlined part, if possible.)

items.prompt: I will buy a new dress tomorrow.
Harry won't help Mum [[in the garden]].
Will we work hard this year?
Sarah and Dave won't come home late.
My parents will go to bed [[because they are tired]].

exercises.title: What will happen when you finish school?
exercises.hint: Schreib eigene Ideen – bewertet wird nur die Grammatik.
